messages:
maya: Quick intake — Acme asked for automatic canary pause + auto-eval during model rollouts. Problem: when we roll out new model versions some customers see quality regressions before metrics/ops catch them. They want an automated canary that pauses traffic and alerts when predefined eval signals degrade. Need to capture goals, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and edge cases so we can draft a PRD.

arjun: Clarifying Q — do they want this for Hosted APIs too or just Dedicated/private setups?

maya: Short: initial priority = Dedicated (reserved pools) + Private. Hosted to follow once we validate gating model. Acme is on Dedicated and wants data isolation.

ella: Draft goals: 1) Auto-pause canary when regression detected vs baseline eval set. 2) Clear rollback path and human-in-the-loop resume. 3) Console shows pause reason + eval diff. 4) Alerting w/ links to failed eval samples.

sam: Non-goals: auto-retraining, automated hyperparameter tuning, or building eval sets for customers. We'll accept customer-provided eval set and thresholds initially.

lena: Customer note from Acme: they only care about semantic quality regressions (precision/recall on labeled eval prompts). They explicitly do NOT want latency to be a gating metric.

maya: Acceptance criteria (first pass):
```
- canary_config: { traffic_fraction: 0.05, eval_set_id: "customer_acme_v1", metric: "exact_match", threshold_delta: -0.03 }
- Detection rule: if canary.metric - baseline.metric <= threshold_delta AND samples >= min_samples -> PAUSE
- System must surface sample examples that triggered pause (up to 20 examples)
- Pause must be reversible via console or API with audit log
- Console shows baseline vs canary metric time series, sample counts, and EWMA-smoothed trend
```

arjun: Edge cases to call out: small canary sample -> noisy estimates, flaky prompts / non-deterministic outputs, model quantization variance across nodes. We need a min_samples and min_time window.

sam: Proposed runtime constraints: min_samples = 200, min_duration = 30m, and require at least 3 independent evaluation batches before enforcing pause. Also need a graceful degrade path if eval pipeline fails (do not auto-pause if eval job is unhealthy).

ella: Observability requirements: per-route eval histograms, smoothed delta (EWMA window configurable), and tagging of which model variant was used. UI should let PMs inspect failing prompts and add them to a suppression list if noisy.

deploy-bot: infra note: implementing auto-pause requires (a) evaluation job queue + workers, (b) webhook to control router to pause traffic for a model version, (c) throttling and rate-limits for eval jobs.

maya: Success metrics for the feature: 1) mean time to detect a true regression < 10m for high-volume canaries; 2) false positive pause rate < 5% across rollouts in first 90 days; 3) customer-reported incidents avoided (Acme says they estimate 1 incident/week prevented is high value).

lena: Acme confirmed 5% traffic for canary is ok and they can provide a labeled eval set of ~5k examples. They'll also accept an initial manual review step before automated rollback. :thumbsup:

maya: Next steps — I'll draft PRD with problem, goals, non-goals, success metrics, API schema for canary_config, and acceptance criteria. Owners: @arjun runtime feasibility + infra impact, @ella console UI + sample surfacing, @sam infra + scheduler. Aim: PRD draft by EOD Friday. Please DM if you need more detail. :eyes:
